evidence: Across 29 consecutive real map releases, dependency-aware repair matched every full rebuild and the next independent snapshot (3,655 highway geometries). Updating only revised ways missed 1 geometry-version discrepancy.
next_decision: Publish a version after reverse dependencies, updated geometries and the sequence have committed together. Keep an indexed historical lookup and periodically verify the source snapshot.
boundary: This is a reproducible experiment on a single regional OSM extract and a local SQLite store. Work counts measure recomputation. System latency and production availability require separate measurement.
